```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(gghalves)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(kableExtra)
library(pairwiseComparisons)
library(psych)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r set specifications}
# Disable scientific notation
options(scipen=999)
source(here("ext", "lm_test.R"))
```

```{r load data}
Neuroethics_Judgement <- read.csv(here("data", "Cleaned_Pilot", "clean_data_long.csv"), stringsAsFactors=TRUE)
data <- Neuroethics_Judgement %>% dplyr::select("user_id", "condition", "sex", "age", "education","ReligionRaised", "ReligionNow", "Spirituality", "AttendChurch", "ReligiousActivity", "meditation", "Religiosity","Political_Party", "conservatismFactor", "Harm", "Fairness", "Loyalty", "Athority", "Sancticy", "cor_pearson", "Yes", "No", "Risk_Beta", "Gain_Beta", "risk_average_marginal_effect", "risk_Std_Err", "risk_z", "risk_P..z.", "gain_average_marginal_effect", "gain_Std_Err", "gain_z", "gain_P..z.") %>% distinct() %>% 
   mutate(dominate = ifelse(Yes >= 75 *.90 | No >= 75 *.90, "dominate", "not_dominate")) %>% 
   filter(!dominate == "dominate")
```

```{r religious variable}
#calculate Religion
data %>% 
   dplyr::select(user_id, ReligionRaised, ReligionNow, Religiosity, Spirituality, 
AttendChurch, ReligiousActivity) -> data.religious

data.religious$AttendChurch <-
  recode_factor(data.religious$AttendChurch,
              `1` = "Never", 
              `2` = "Once a year or less", 
              `3` = "A few times a year",
              `4` = "A few times a month", 
              `5` = "Once a week", 
              `6` = "More than once a week", .ordered = TRUE)

data.religious$ReligiousActivity <-
  recode_factor(data.religious$ReligiousActivity,
              `1` = "Never", 
              `2` = "Once a year or less", 
              `3` = "A few times a year",
              `4` = "A few times a month", 
              `5` = "Once a week", 
              `6` = "More than once a week", .ordered = TRUE)

data.religious$Religiosity <-
  recode_factor(data.religious$Religiosity,
              `1` = "Not Religious", 
              `2` = "Somewhat Religious", 
              `3` = "Very Religious",
              `4` = "Extremely Religious", .ordered = TRUE)

data.religious$Spirituality <-
  recode_factor(data.religious$Spirituality,
              `1` = "Not Spiritual", 
              `2` = "Somewhat Spiritual", 
              `3` = "Very Spiritual",
              `4` = "Extremely Spiritual", .ordered = TRUE)
              
religious <- data.matrix(data.religious[,c("Religiosity", "Spirituality", "AttendChurch", "ReligiousActivity")]) - 1

#Kaiser-Meyer-Olkin factor adequacy
KMO <- psych::KMO(religious)
KMO
KMO$ImCov
#	Bartlett's Test of Sphericity
REdaS::bart_spher(religious)

scree <- psych::polychoric(religious)$rho
evals <- eigen(scree)$values
print(scree, cutoff = "0.3")
psych::scree(scree, factors = F)

EFA <- fa(religious, nfactors = 1, rotate = "oblimin", fm ="ml")
print(EFA$loadings, cutoff = "0.4")
#round(EFA$Phi, 3)
(evals/sum(evals)*100)[1:4]
EFA$communalities

religious.efa <- fa(religious, nfactors = 1, rotate = "oblimin", fm ="ml", cor = "poly", scores = "regression")
print(religious.efa)
#fa.diagram(religious.efa)

print(religious.efa$loadings, cutoff = "0.3")
data$ReligiousFactor<- as.numeric(religious.efa$scores)
```

```{r variable prep, echo=FALSE}
#relevel
data$Political_Party <- relevel(data$Political_Party, "Democrat")
data$Religiosity <- relevel(data$Religiosity, "Not Religious")
#rename
names(data)[names(data) == 'Sancticy'] <- 'Sanctity'
names(data)[names(data) == 'Athority'] <- 'Authority'

#potential outliers from cook's D
#data = data[c(-117,-301, -405),]

#check the residuals 
#ggResidpanel::resid_panel(lm.political.risk, plots = "all")
data = data[-329,]#gain outlier. Has influence on results
#data= filter(data, !user_id == "xTDQTle7")
data= filter(data, !user_id == "fhdEZjgH") #all zeros for moral foundations
```


```{r calculate regressions}
#get the names of the variables
expl = names(data)[12:19]
expl = append(expl, "ReligiousFactor")
#run risk models
models_risk = expl %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map(risk_lm_test)

#take a look
map(models_risk, summary) -> f

map(f, pluck("fstatistic")) #get all the F stats!!

map_df(models_risk, glance)
map_df(models_risk, tidy)

#run gain models
models_gain = expl %>% 
  set_names() %>% 
  map(gain_lm_test)

map(models_gain, summary)

#take a look
map_df(models_gain, glance)
map_df(models_gain, tidy)

```
For moral intuitions, hypothesized higher scores on foundations of Authority, Loyalty, and Sanctity will be more risk sensitive than those who score high on Harm and Fairness.

Take the average AVE of each of these grouped by the scores in 5 bins each, and test for differences?
```{r plot the Moral Foundations}
data %>% 
  dplyr::select("user_id", "Harm", "Fairness", "Loyalty", "Authority", "Sanctity") %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = "user_id" , variable.name = "value", value.name = "score") -> plotdata

plotdata <- merge(data[,c("user_id", "risk_average_marginal_effect")], plotdata, "user_id")

ggplot(plotdata, aes(score,risk_average_marginal_effect, group = value, color = value))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~value)+
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Marginal Effect of Risk by Moral Foundations",
       x = "Score", 
       y = "Average Marginal Effect: Risk",
       color = "Attribute")+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", size=.25)

###gain
plotdata <- merge(data[,c("user_id", "gain_average_marginal_effect")], plotdata, "user_id")

ggplot(plotdata, aes(score,gain_average_marginal_effect, group = value, color = value))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black")+
  facet_wrap(~value)+
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Average Marginal Effect of Gain by Moral Foundations",
       x = "Score", 
       y = "Average Marginal Effect: Gain",
       color = "Attribute")+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", size=.25)
```

```{r broken stick regressions Risk, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
data %>% 
  select(risk_average_marginal_effect, conservatismFactor) %>% 
  mutate(knot = as.factor(ifelse(conservatismFactor >= 0, 1, 0)))-> test
test = test[c(-117,-404),]

m1 = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor+knot, data = test)
m2 = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor*knot, data = test)
anova(m1,m2)
knot1 = broom::glance(m2)
ggplot(test, aes(conservatismFactor, risk_average_marginal_effect, group = knot, fill = knot))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",se =F, color = "red")+ theme_minimal()


data %>% 
  select(risk_average_marginal_effect, conservatismFactor) %>% 
  mutate(knot = as.factor(ifelse(conservatismFactor > 0, 1, 0)))-> test
test = test[c(-117,-404),]

m1 = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor+knot, data = test)
m2 = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor*knot, data = test)
anova(m1,m2)
knot2 = broom::glance(m2)

ggplot(test, aes(conservatismFactor, risk_average_marginal_effect, group = knot, fill = knot))+
  geom_jitter()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se =F, color = "red")+ theme_minimal()

knots = rbind(knot1, knot2)
knots
#ggResidpanel::resid_panel(m2, plots = "all")
broom::tidy(m2) %>% 
  kable()%>%  
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
```

```{r trying more peicewise regressions, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(plotly)
library(segmented)

data %>% 
  select(risk_average_marginal_effect, conservatismFactor) %>% 
  mutate(knot = ifelse(conservatismFactor > 0, 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(X = conservatismFactor*knot)-> test
test = test[c(-117,-404),]
m0 = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor, data = test)
m1 = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor+X, data = test)
m2 = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor*X, data = test)
anova(m0,m1,m2)
knot1 = broom::glance(m1)
ggplot(test, aes(conservatismFactor, risk_average_marginal_effect, group = X))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",se =F, color = "red")+ theme_minimal()

plot(risk_average_marginal_effect~conservatismFactor, test)
lines(test$conservatismFactor, predict(m1), col = "blue")
#equatiomatic::extract_eq(m1,   intercept = "beta",  use_coefs = T,  coef_digits = 5)

fit = lm(risk_average_marginal_effect ~ conservatismFactor, data = test)

fit_seg <- segmented(fit, seg.Z = ~conservatismFactor, psi = list(conservatismFactor=0))

summary(fit_seg)

plot_ly(test,x=~conservatismFactor,
        y=~risk_average_marginal_effect,
        type="scatter") %>% add_lines(x =  ~conservatismFactor, y = fitted(fit_seg))
```

$\begin{aligned}\operatorname{\log\left[ \frac { P( \operatorname{treatment}) }{ 1 - P( \operatorname{treatment}) } \right]}  &\sim N \left(\mu, \sigma^2 \right) \\ \mu &=\beta_{0i} + \beta_{1i}(\operatorname{risk}) + \beta_{2i}(\operatorname{gain}) \\\beta_{0j}  &\sim N \left(\mu_{\beta_{i}}, \sigma^2_{\beta_{j}} \right) \text{, for Individual i = 1,} \dots \text{,I} \end{aligned}$
